title: HR 来电口头 offer，谈入职日期和薪酬
titleEn: Taking a verbal job offer and talking start date and pay
scene: 你上周面试了一家能源公司的 Business Analyst 长期岗。今天下午 HR（Talent Acquisition）的 Megan 打来电话，说团队很喜欢你，想先口头给你 offer。她语速很快，一口气讲薪资、super、试用期、hybrid 安排，还会问你什么时候能入职、现在公司的 notice period 多长。
你的目标：① 听懂 offer 的关键数字（base salary、super 是否另算、试用期）；② 礼貌地说要考虑一下，并试着谈一点薪资或入职日期，不要当场答应；③ 请她把书面合同和细节发邮件，确认回复期限。

facts.v: 希望 11 月 16 日；你需要 4 周 notice
下周三 COB 前给答复

vocab.zh: 口头 offer（正式合同之后才发）
vocab.ex: I'm ringing to make you a verbal offer.
The base salary is a hundred and eighteen thousand.

vocab.zh: super 另算 / 已包含 super
vocab.ex: Is that plus super, or inclusive of super?
The total package comes to around one thirty-two.
There's a standard six-month probation period.
What's your notice period at your current job?
I can hand in my notice once I've signed.

vocab.en: a bit of movement / wiggle room
vocab.ex: Is there any movement on the base?

vocab.en: go back to the hiring manager
vocab.ex: Let me go back to the hiring manager and see.

vocab.zh: 税前工资打包（如多放 super、novated lease）
vocab.ex: We do offer salary packaging as well.
The contract should come through on Monday.
Do you mind if I sleep on it over the weekend?

listening.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Megan from the talent team — got a sec? I've got some good news for ya.
listening.sound: got a sec 连读 "go-da-sec" = 有空吗；for ya = for you，ya 很轻
listening.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是招聘团队的 Megan——有空吗？有好消息告诉你。
listening.reply: Hi Megan, yes, I've got a few minutes. Thanks for calling.

listening.en: So the team were really impressed, and we'd love to offer you the role — I'm just ringing to make you a verbal offer.
listening.sound: were really impressed 连成一串；ringing = 打电话（澳洲常用 ring 不用 call）
listening.zh: 团队对你印象很好，我们想把这个职位给你——我打电话是先口头给你 offer。
listening.reply: That's fantastic news, thank you! I'd love to hear the details.

listening.en: We're looking at one-eighteen base, plus super on top, so all up it's sitting around one thirty-two.
listening.sound: one-eighteen = $118,000，澳洲人报薪资常省掉 thousand；all up = 加起来总共；sitting around = 大约在
listening.zh: 基本工资是 11.8 万，super 另算，加起来大概 13.2 万。
listening.reply: Thanks. Just to confirm, that's one hundred and eighteen thousand base, plus super?

listening.en: It's a six-month probation, which is pretty standard, and you'd be in the office three days a week — Tuesdays to Thursdays, give or take.
listening.sound: probation 重音在 "ba"；give or take = 大概，不一定
listening.zh: 试用期六个月，挺标准的；每周三天在办公室——大概周二到周四。
listening.reply: That sounds fine. Is there any flexibility on which days?

listening.en: I can't promise anything, but I'm happy to go back to the hiring manager and see if there's a bit of wriggle room.
listening.sound: wriggle room = wiggle room，可调整的空间；go back to 连读 "go-back-ta"
listening.zh: 我不能保证，但我可以回去问问用人经理，看有没有调整空间。
listening.reply: Thank you, I really appreciate that.

listening.en: No dramas — I'll pop the contract through on Monday, and if you could let me know by Wednesday COB, that'd be ace.
listening.sound: no dramas = 没问题；pop it through = 发过来；COB = close of business 下班前；ace = 太好了
listening.zh: 没问题——周一我把合同发给你，你能在周三下班前告诉我就太好了。
listening.reply: Sounds good. I'll get back to you by Wednesday at the latest.

speech.topic: 我怎么准备谈工作 offer
paragraphs: Getting a job offer is exciting, but it can also be a bit stressful, especially when the call comes out of the blue. In Australia, the recruiter or HR person often rings you first with a verbal offer, and then the written contract comes through a few days later. I've learned that I don't have to say yes on the spot.

When I get the call, I try to stay calm and write down the key numbers. The most important question is whether the salary is plus super or inclusive of super, because that can make a difference of more than ten thousand dollars. I also ask about the probation period, the hybrid arrangement, and when they would like me to start.

Before I talk about money, I always thank them and say I'm really keen on the role. Then I politely ask if there is any movement on the base salary. I usually give a reason, like my experience with similar projects or the market rate for this kind of role. If they can't move on the salary, I sometimes ask for something else, like a later start date or an extra day working from home.

Finally, I ask them to send everything in writing, and I confirm when they need my answer. I like to sleep on it and talk it over with my family. A good employer will understand that. In my experience, being polite but clear is the best way to get a fair deal and start a new job on the right foot.
speech.zh: 拿到 offer 很开心，但电话常常来得突然，会有点紧张。在澳洲通常先接到口头 offer，几天后才有书面合同，所以不用当场答应。接电话时我会冷静记下关键数字：最重要的是薪资含不含 super，差别可能超过一万；还要问试用期、hybrid 安排和入职时间。谈钱之前先感谢对方、表达对职位的兴趣，再礼貌地问基本工资有没有调整空间，并给出理由；如果工资谈不动，可以争取晚一点入职或多一天在家办公。最后请对方书面发过来，确认答复期限，自己考虑一晚、和家人商量。礼貌而清楚，是拿到公平待遇、好好开始新工作的最佳方式。

patterns.en: Just to confirm, is that ___ plus super, or inclusive of super?
patterns.zh: 确认薪资数字和 super 是否另算

patterns.en: I'm really keen on the role. Is there any movement on ___?
patterns.zh: 先表态感兴趣，再问某项能不能调整

patterns.en: Based on my experience with ___, I was hoping for something closer to ___.
patterns.zh: 给出理由，提出期望数字

patterns.en: Would it be possible to ___ instead?
patterns.zh: 工资谈不动时，争取别的条件（入职日期、在家办公）

other.name: Megan
other.role: 公司 HR 招聘专员

lines.en: Hi, is that Amy? It's Megan from the talent team at Southern Grid Energy. Got a sec?
lines.zh: 你好，是 Amy 吗？我是 Southern Grid Energy 招聘团队的 Megan。有空吗？

lines.en: Hi Megan, yes, I've got a few minutes. How are you?
lines.zh: 你好 Megan，有的，我有几分钟。你好吗？

lines.en: Yeah, good, thanks! Look, I won't keep you long. The team were really impressed with you on Tuesday, so I'm ringing to make you a verbal offer for the BA role.
lines.zh: 挺好，谢谢！我不耽误你太久。周二团队对你印象很好，所以我打电话来口头给你这个 BA 职位的 offer。

lines.en: Oh, that's fantastic news. Thank you so much! I'd love to hear the details.
lines.zh: 哇，太好了，非常感谢！我想听听具体细节。

lines.en: Course. So it's a permanent full-time role, we're looking at one-eighteen base, plus super on top, so all up it's sitting around one thirty-two, and there's a six-month probation, which is pretty standard.
lines.zh: 当然。这是长期全职岗，基本工资 11.8 万，super 另算，加起来大约 13.2 万，试用期六个月，挺标准的。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? I want to write it down.
lines.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再讲一遍吗？我想记下来。

lines.en: Ha, no worries. One hundred and eighteen thousand base. Super's on top of that. Six months' probation.
lines.zh: 哈，没事。基本工资十一万八千。super 另外加。试用期六个月。

lines.en: Got it, thanks. Just to confirm, the hundred and eighteen doesn't include super, right?
lines.zh: 记下了，谢谢。确认一下，十一万八不包含 super，对吧？

lines.en: That's right, super's separate. And it's hybrid — three days in the office, usually Tuesday to Thursday, give or take, depending on the project.
lines.zh: 对，super 单独算。工作是 hybrid 的——每周三天在办公室，一般周二到周四，大概这样，看项目而定。

lines.en: That sounds good. And when were you hoping I could start?
lines.zh: 听起来不错。你们希望我什么时候入职？

lines.en: Ideally the sixteenth of November — the project kicks off that week. What's your notice period looking like at the moment?
lines.zh: 最好是 11 月 16 日——项目那周启动。你现在的 notice period 是多长？

lines.en: It's four weeks, so if I sign next week and hand in my notice straight away, the earliest would be around the twenty-third.
lines.zh: 四周，所以如果我下周签、马上递辞呈，最早大概 23 号。

lines.en: Okay, yeah, that should be fine, I reckon. I'll just double-check with Paul, but a week either way's no biggie.
lines.zh: 好的，我觉得应该没问题。我跟 Paul 再确认一下，前后差一周不算大事。

lines.en: Thanks. Megan, I'm really keen on the role. I just wanted to ask — is there any movement on the base salary?
lines.zh: 谢谢。Megan，我真的很想要这个职位。我想问一下——基本工资有调整空间吗？

lines.en: Mm, what sort of number did you have in mind?
lines.zh: 嗯，你心里大概是多少？

lines.en: Based on my experience with billing and payments projects, I was hoping for something closer to one twenty-five.
lines.zh: 基于我做账单和支付类项目的经验，我希望更接近 12.5 万。

lines.en: Right. I can't promise anything — the band's fairly tight for this one — but I'm happy to go back to the hiring manager and see if there's a bit of wriggle room.
lines.zh: 明白。我不能保证——这个岗位的薪资区间挺紧的——但我可以回去问问用人经理，看有没有一点空间。

lines.en: Thank you, I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: 谢谢，非常感激。

lines.en: Actually, hang on, he's just walked past — give me two ticks.
lines.zh: 哎，等一下，他刚好从旁边走过——给我两分钟。

lines.en: Okay, sorry about that. So Paul reckons he can stretch to one twenty-two, plus super, but that's pretty much the top of the band. We also do salary packaging, if that's any help.
lines.zh: 好了，不好意思。Paul 说最多可以到 12.2 万加 super，基本就是区间顶了。我们也有 salary packaging，看对你有没有帮助。

lines.en: That's great, thank you. Just to check, by salary packaging, you mean I can put extra into super before tax?
lines.zh: 太好了，谢谢。确认一下，你说的 salary packaging 是指我可以税前多放钱进 super 吗？

lines.en: Yep, super, or a novated lease on a car — it's all in the policy. I'll pop it in the email.
lines.zh: 对，可以放 super，也可以做汽车的 novated lease——政策里都有。我会放在邮件里。

lines.en: Perfect. Would you mind sending the offer and the contract in writing? I'd like to sleep on it and talk it over with my family.
lines.zh: 好的。你能把 offer 和合同书面发给我吗？我想考虑一晚，和家人商量一下。

lines.en: No dramas at all. I'll pop the contract through on Monday morning, and if you could let me know by Wednesday COB, that'd be ace.
lines.zh: 完全没问题。我周一早上把合同发给你，你能在周三下班前给我答复就太好了。

lines.en: Sounds good. So, Wednesday close of business. Thanks again, Megan — have a lovely weekend.
lines.zh: 好的。那就周三下班前。再次感谢，Megan——周末愉快。

lines.en: You too, Amy. Congrats again — chat soon!
lines.zh: 你也是，Amy。再次恭喜——回头聊！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that number again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，那个数字能说慢一点再讲一遍吗？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, is that plus super, or including super?
rescue.zh: 确认一下，是 super 另算，还是已包含？

rescue.en: Sorry, I'm not familiar with that term. What does it mean exactly?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，这个词我不熟，具体是什么意思？

rescue.en: Would you mind putting all of that in an email for me?
rescue.zh: 能麻烦你把这些都写在邮件里发给我吗？

rescue.en: Can I have a think about it and get back to you by ___?
rescue.zh: 我能考虑一下，___ 之前回复你吗？

checklist: 我能听懂 "one-eighteen base, plus super on top" 这种省略 thousand 的报薪方式
我会问 plus super 还是 inclusive of super，并复述确认数字
我能说出自己的 notice period，并算出最早入职日期
我能先表态 "I'm really keen on the role"，再礼貌地问 "Is there any movement on the base?"
我能给出理由并提出一个具体期望数字
我不当场答应，会要求书面合同并确认回复期限（Wednesday COB）
